> XVIII Picking Locks and Deciphering Interview with Vidocq⁠—Remarkable Power of altering his Height⁠—A Bungler in picking Locks⁠—Mr. Hobbs’s Lock and the Duke of Wellington⁠—Strong belief that certain Ciphers are inscrutable⁠—Davies Gilbert’s Cipher⁠—The Author’s Cipher both deciphered⁠—Classified Dictionaries of the English Language⁠—Anagrams⁠—Squaring Words⁠—Bishop not easily squared⁠—Lesser Dignitaries easier to work upon. These two subjects are in truth much more nearly allied than might appear upon a superficial view of them. They are in fact closely connected with each other as small branches of the same vast subject of combinations. Several years ago, the celebrated thief-taker, Vidocq, paid a short visit to London.
